actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
if [ ! -f /app/alpine.iso ]; then echo 'missing /app/alpine.iso' >&2; exit 1; fi
# Try to start QEMU in the background with telnet on localhost:6665.
# Use a detached shell so the VM keeps running after this command returns.
nohup sh -lc '
  exec qemu-system-x86_64 \
    -m 512 \
    -cdrom /app/alpine.iso \
    -boot d \
    -nographic \
    -serial telnet:127.0.0.1:6665,server,nowait \
    -monitor none
' >/tmp/alpine-qemu.log 2>&1 &
echo $!

set -euo pipefail
# Show the launch log and confirm the QEMU process is still running.
cat /tmp/alpine-qemu.log || true
pgrep -af 'qemu-system-x86_64.*6665|qemu-system-x86_64.*alpine.iso' || true

model_notes.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 reaches a login prompt and the VM stays running.
verification_plan: Launch QEMU in background with serial exposed on telnet localhost:6665
Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt is observable
Confirm the QEMU process remains running
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command
Receipt-backed evidence that the telnet session shows a login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving qemu starts without exposing telnet on port 6665
Only checking file existence or non-empty output
Leaving the VM not running after the command exits
